name: tokenized-deposit-template
capabilities: create deposit holdings against a Daml template
expose a typed JSON API surface for the frontend stub
generate a scaffold with the Daml package, frontend stub and README
description: Minimal tokenized deposit component for DPM. It ships one Daml template, a Ledger API adapter and a frontend stub, so a reviewer can read every line in a few minutes and a team can copy it as a starting point. Status: reference entry. The OCI artifact is not published yet, and the sha256 covers the component source bundle in this repository, not a registry image.
